value.content:
A slash command is a Markdown file in .claude/commands, and its file name becomes the command. This one, /revisar, runs ruff check and pytest and returns only the errors, with file and line. Here the output points to the same kind of bug: a list default that keeps data between calls.

The presenter is a drawing made from my photos; the voice is mine, cloned by AI.

#Shorts #ClaudeCode #Programming #Dev

settings.title: One slash command runs your linter and tests
